verdict.rationale: gstack gives teams some control over updates. It supports a vendored, project-local install distinct from a global one, and project-local setup never silently replaces the global install. Upgrades run through an explicit /gstack-upgrade skill, and automatic upgrading is gated behind a GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE setting. However, there is no documented version pinning, lockfile, or team-wide mechanism for choosing a release, and a community commenter notes the git-clone-and-copy install model may strain when repos need divergent setups. missing for 10: explicit version pinning or lockfile, documented team rollout/version-selection workflow, clear docs on auto-upgrade defaults, independent hands-on corroboration.
